items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: I started in World War I, playing for Dr. O' Kelly, playing for the 12-night revels.

ctx.x: He'd do that sort of Tiger Rag, or they...

And then, the Tiger Rag is good until the day, and we all had to play it a whole lot of time. But I don't know, we had something about us. People used to like our style of playing, buddy. You know, they had the big white parties and all that kind of stuff. They didn't have them bands. None of them. And I had the afternoon. I used to play a tuxedo band. I used to play all of the carnival bars. I played most of all of the carnival bars. I started in World War I, playing for Dr. O' Kelly, playing for the 12-night…
Did you play any of the parades during carnival too? Yes sir.
